layout: Per seed: one all-actual-parent control plus one single-candidate game in every seat. Shared control yields paired per-seat contrasts; the seed block is the independent unit.
scoring: Canonical discrete area at natural terminal only. Preserve truncated receipts and exclude their win/loss values. Report complete-case selection bias and exact natural/paired denominators.
selection: Fixed update-100 candidates from application-train-r1; no arena-based checkpoint selection or promotion.
scope: Small application pilot against the actual easy/medium product runtime, including terminal-winning PASS, standard defense gate and three-v4 rollout. Candidate remains standalone linear17 with its learned PASS coefficient. Hard, Ultimate, multiple-candidate lineups, other contexts, devices and admission are excluded. No formal strength claim.
